Spot Bitcoin ETFs post $45.7M net inflow Tuesday, extending Monday's rebound; ETH ETFs add $6.7M –
Link
U.S. spot BTC ETFs added $45.7M on Aug 18 after Monday's ≈$298M inflow, while ETH ETFs saw $6.7M in inflows. The pace is slower, but the data suggests institutional demand is stabilizing after last week's heavy outflows.
Matters because: Repeated inflows usually help confirm that ETF demand is recovering, though the slower pace still points to cautious positioning rather than a strong reversal.

Sec proposes first-ever comprehensive crypto rulemaking ("Regulation Crypto Assets") –
Link
The SEC proposed a framework on Aug 18 with a "Startup Exemption" of up to $5M for 4 years, a "Fundraising Exemption" of up to $75M for 1 year, and a safe-harbor path for tokens to move out of security status once projects decentralize. The 60-day comment period is now open while Congress's CLARITY Act remains stalled.
Matters because: Clearer token-issuance rules could lower legal risk for U.S. launches and support new project formation, even though implementation is still months away.
